package.name: debbuilder
package.description: web interface for reproducible Debian package pipelines

source_changes.content:
DEBBUILDER_HOST=127.0.0.1
DEBBUILDER_PORT=8099
DEBBUILDER_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/debbuilder
DEBBUILDER_REPO_ROOT=/var/lib/debbuilder/repository
DEBBUILDER_REPO_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8099
DEBBUILDER_SUITE=Luminous
DEBBUILDER_COMPONENT=main
DEBBUILDER_AUTH_MODE=none
DEBBUILDER_ALLOW_REAL_RUN=0
DEBBUILDER_ALLOW_UNSAFE_BUILD_COMMAND=0
DEBBUILDER_BUILD_TEMP_DIR=/var/lib/debbuilder/build-workspaces/${WORKFLOW_NAME}
GNUPGHOME=/var/lib/debbuilder/.gnupg

maintainer_scripts.preinst:
getent group debbuilder >/dev/null 2>&1 || addgroup --system debbuilder
id -u debbuilder >/dev/null 2>&1 || adduser --system --ingroup debbuilder --home /var/lib/debbuilder --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin debbuilder
install -d -m 0750 -o debbuilder -g debbuilder /var/lib/debbuilder /var/lib/debbuilder/workflows /var/lib/debbuilder/runs /var/lib/debbuilder/builds /var/lib/debbuilder/build-workspaces /var/lib/debbuilder/repository
maintainer_scripts.postrm:
if [ "$1" = purge ]; then
  rm -rf -- /var/lib/debbuilder
  deluser --system debbuilder >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  delgroup --system debbuilder >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
